stocks.headline: Earnings came out ahead of forecasts and the stock is 3.0% higher before the open at 160.09, despite the CEO scandal.
stocks.why: Sales are up 106% from a year ago and growth is speeding up. Operating margin is 65%. Next year's profit forecasts rose 23% in 90 days. The stock costs 9.8 times next year's profit, the cheapest in 5 years. So the stock fell 28.2% in 20 days because of the leadership crisis, not because demand weakened. The CEO resigned, an interim CEO is in charge, staff are split, and a congressional probe and a China report add political risk. A rally that holds here lifts TSM, AVGO, MU, SMCI and the neoclouds with it.

long_term.reason: The business is stronger than ever and the price is low, but there is no permanent CEO and no numeric outlook. Leadership risk outweighs the cheap price until a successor is named.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A credible permanent CEO, with no new findings against the company in the probes, makes this an Add on dips.
stocks.action: Don't buy the open at 160.09; buy a trading position only if it trades above 163.20 after the first hour.

stocks.headline: The neocloud is bouncing 3.8% before the open to 51.80 on Nvidia's results, after a 19.7% drop in 20 days.
stocks.why: The bounce comes from Nvidia's results, not from anything CoreWeave did. The business still loses money: a loss of $1.27 per share last quarter and a -1% operating margin. It carries $24.9B of long-term debt against $4.1B of cash, so higher rates (the 10-year is at 5.12) raise its costs directly. The $132.3B backlog is real, but Microsoft plans to use fewer neoclouds and a well-known investor has called the group 'in big trouble'. If this bounce fails, it shows the market still doubts the AI buildout, and that hits ORCL and SMCI too.

long_term.reason: Fast sales growth, but losses, heavy debt and rising rates make it the weakest link in the AI chain. This agrees with the house view of avoiding it.

stocks.what_would_change_it: Positive operating profit, or new contracts that cut its reliance on borrowing, would turn this into a Wait.
stocks.action: Don't buy the bounce; if you own it, use any move toward 52.06 to sell.
